info.title: ytx extracts YouTube video metadata and captions as JSON.
info.description: Extract YouTube title, description, and transcript (raw + Markdown) as JSON.

options.name: --url
options.description: Specify the YouTube URL or video ID explicitly.

options.name: --language
options.description:
Prefer captions matching a language name or code
(default: English).

options.name: --metadata-only
options.description: Skip caption retrieval and return metadata only.

options.name: --compact
options.description: Write compact JSON instead of indented JSON.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version and exit.
Output:
JSON is written to stdout. Diagnostics are written to stderr.
Exit codes:
0  Success
1  Video retrieval or another runtime error
2  Invalid command-line usage or input

arguments.name: URL_OR_VIDEO_ID
arguments.description: A YouTube URL or video ID.
